cases.case_label: L1 orphan 3' transduction (chr11q22.3 sequence) in DMD exon 67
cases.mechanism_detail: The insertion in DMD exon 67 consists solely of a copy of chr11q22.3 sequence lying directly downstream of a non-reference, highly active full-length L1 (LRE4) present in the proband and mother; it is explained as an L1-mediated 3' transduction with severe 5' truncation (no L1 sequence), disrupting exon 67.
cases.quote: Thus, the likely explanation for the mutagenic insertion is a LINE-1-mediated 3’ transduction with severe 5’ truncation.
